subject: Intro + demo options for ClearStream AI — flexible timing / async option
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@clearstream.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in a demo — best time?

Hi Logan,

I signed up for a trial this morning and I'm leading the evaluation for ClearStream AI. I'm in Barcelona (CEST), so earlier in the mornings my team is more available. Would love a 20–30 minute walkthrough focused on latency / cost savings for streaming workloads.

We have a tight timeline — hoping to decide tooling by end of month. If live times are challenging, a recorded walkthrough + 15-min live Q&A would also work.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
VP of Platform, ClearStream AI
marta@clearstream.ai

---

Hi Marta — great to meet you and congrats on the trial kickoff. I'm Logan on the solutions team. Appreciate the timeline.

Quick proposal:
- Option A: 20-min live walkthrough + Q&A (we'll tailor to real-time streaming & cost tradeoffs) — Tue 14 Oct 09:00 CEST or Wed 15 Oct 08:00 CEST.
- Option B: short recorded walkthrough (10–12 min) focused on our latency optimizations + a 15-min live slot for Q&A at your convenience.

If you prefer, Tessa (cc'd) can offer an evening US slot that maps to your morning. I've attached a one-pager that highlights throughput/latency wins for streaming use-cases.

Calendly (pick a time): https://calendly.com/redwood/logan-30

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (1-page summary)

Let us know which you prefer and we’ll lock it in. If you want the recording first, we can share it within 24 hours and then book a short follow-up.

Best,
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
